releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* fix(depth): stop the game aborting on OpenGL 4.1 (macOS) by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/307
* ci(changelog): write each entry as a file of its own by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/334
* feat(config): add a hiddenMobs list of mobs never shown far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/292
* perf(track): spread saved-data work done in bursts on the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/208
* perf(track): read the mob memory and save offline players off the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/335
* feat(mobs): roll minecarts on along their rails, keep riders in their ride by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/120
* fix(mobs): keep Ambient Birds' birds flying far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/251
* perf(depth): work on the far terrain's depth around the far figures only by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/199
* fix(compat): draw Lycanites Mobs' queued models and leave ships to Valkyrien Skies by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/255
* fix(mobs): lower the learnt reach when the server sends less far by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/283
* fix(birds): keep bats and flying birds out of the player's reach by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/41
* fix(offline): keep offline players in place and let them fall off edges by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/338
* fix(mobs): animate the ender dragon far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/337
* fix(impostors): apply simplification thresholds to players online by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/336
* perf(mobs): spend less time on thousands of distant mobs by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/323
* feat(mobs): option to hide distant mobs underground by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/90
* feat(changelog): changelog in every language the mod ships by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/340
* fix(players): keep the Minecraft Comes Alive look of offline players by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/341
* chore(skills): add announce-test-build to call testers on Discord by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/342
* fix(memory): draw no mob of another dimension by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/344
* fix(depth): save the scissor box around Distant Horizons' merge by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/345


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/compare/v0.16.0...v0.17.0-dev.757

* perf(mobs): spend less time on thousands of distant mobs by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/323
* feat(mobs): option to hide distant mobs underground by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/90
* feat(changelog): changelog in every language the mod ships by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/340
* fix(players): keep the Minecraft Comes Alive look of offline players by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/341

* ci(changelog): write each entry as a file of its own by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/334
* feat(config): add a hiddenMobs list of mobs never shown far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/292
* perf(track): spread saved-data work done in bursts on the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/208
* perf(track): read the mob memory and save offline players off the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/335
* feat(mobs): roll minecarts on along their rails, keep riders in their ride by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/120
* fix(mobs): keep Ambient Birds' birds flying far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/251
* perf(depth): work on the far terrain's depth around the far figures only by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/199
* fix(compat): draw Lycanites Mobs' queued models and leave ships to Valkyrien Skies by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/255
* fix(mobs): lower the learnt reach when the server sends less far by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/283
* fix(birds): keep bats and flying birds out of the player's reach by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/41
* fix(offline): keep offline players in place and let them fall off edges by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/338

* feat(mobs): option to hide distant mobs underground by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/90
* feat(changelog): changelog in every language the mod ships by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/340

## What's Changed
* fix(depth): stop the game aborting on OpenGL 4.1 (macOS) by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/307
* ci(changelog): write each entry as a file of its own by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/334
* feat(config): add a hiddenMobs list of mobs never shown far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/292
* perf(track): spread saved-data work done in bursts on the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/208
* perf(track): read the mob memory and save offline players off the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/335
* feat(mobs): roll minecarts on along their rails, keep riders in their ride by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/120
* fix(mobs): keep Ambient Birds' birds flying far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/251
* perf(depth): work on the far terrain's depth around the far figures only by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/199
* fix(compat): draw Lycanites Mobs' queued models and leave ships to Valkyrien Skies by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/255
* fix(mobs): lower the learnt reach when the server sends less far by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/283
* fix(birds): keep bats and flying birds out of the player's reach by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/41
* fix(offline): keep offline players in place and let them fall off edges by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/338
* fix(mobs): animate the ender dragon far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/337
* fix(impostors): apply simplification thresholds to players online by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/336
* perf(mobs): spend less time on thousands of distant mobs by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/323

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* fix(depth): stop the game aborting on OpenGL 4.1 (macOS) by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/307
* ci(changelog): write each entry as a file of its own by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/334
* feat(config): add a hiddenMobs list of mobs never shown far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/292
* perf(track): spread saved-data work done in bursts on the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/208
* perf(track): read the mob memory and save offline players off the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/335
* feat(mobs): roll minecarts on along their rails, keep riders in their ride by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/120
* fix(mobs): keep Ambient Birds' birds flying far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/251
* perf(depth): work on the far terrain's depth around the far figures only by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/199
* fix(compat): draw Lycanites Mobs' queued models and leave ships to Valkyrien Skies by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/255
* fix(mobs): lower the learnt reach when the server sends less far by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/283
* fix(birds): keep bats and flying birds out of the player's reach by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/41
* fix(offline): keep offline players in place and let them fall off edges by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/338

## What's Changed
* fix(depth): stop the game aborting on OpenGL 4.1 (macOS) by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/307
* ci(changelog): write each entry as a file of its own by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/334
* feat(config): add a hiddenMobs list of mobs never shown far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/292
* perf(track): spread saved-data work done in bursts on the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/208
* perf(track): read the mob memory and save offline players off the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/335
* feat(mobs): roll minecarts on along their rails, keep riders in their ride by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/120
* fix(mobs): keep Ambient Birds' birds flying far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/251
* perf(depth): work on the far terrain's depth around the far figures only by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/199
* fix(compat): draw Lycanites Mobs' queued models and leave ships to Valkyrien Skies by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/255
* fix(mobs): lower the learnt reach when the server sends less far by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/283

## What's Changed
* fix(depth): stop the game aborting on OpenGL 4.1 (macOS) by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/307
* ci(changelog): write each entry as a file of its own by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/334
* feat(config): add a hiddenMobs list of mobs never shown far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/292
* perf(track): spread saved-data work done in bursts on the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/208
* perf(track): read the mob memory and save offline players off the render thread by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/335
* feat(mobs): roll minecarts on along their rails, keep riders in their ride by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/120
* fix(mobs): keep Ambient Birds' birds flying far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/251
* perf(depth): work on the far terrain's depth around the far figures only by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/199

## What's Changed
* feat(compat): hide distant figures behind Lodistance's terrain by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/311
* docs(skills): add a skill for supporting far-terrain mods by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/312
* fix(forge): draw the debug panel and offline names on Forge 1.20.x by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/315
* feat(compat): read Far View's terrain for distant mobs by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/310
* feat(compat): read Ecstatic's terrain and match its far plane by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/309
* fix(compat): hand over to copies at the server's view distance with Bobby by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/316
* feat(ambient): add easter eggs 8 to 21, rework 6 and 7 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/313
* fix(ambient): easter eggs 9, 11, 15 and 19 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/318
* fix: keep Shippy Ships' galleon past the render distance, pictured whole by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/321
* feat(impostors): light simplified mobs with shader packs' normal maps by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/327
* feat(impostors): turn models to their picture's angle before the switch by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/326
* build(release): publish the NeoForge 1.21.4 and 1.21.11 builds as beta by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/322

* feat(ambient): add easter eggs 8 to 21, rework 6 and 7 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/313
* fix(ambient): easter eggs 9, 11, 15 and 19 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/318
* fix: keep Shippy Ships' galleon past the render distance, pictured whole by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/321

* feat(impostors): turn models to their picture's angle before the switch by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/326

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* feat(ui): add Modrinth, CurseForge, Nexus Mods and website links by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/296
* feat(impostors): let Simplification Distance be turned off by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/302
* feat(ambient): change when easter eggs 3, 4 and 5 may come by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/299
* feat(players): show distant players gliding with an elytra by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/250
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/297
* feat(ui): draw distance settings in the world while they are set by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/298
* perf(impostors): find saved sheets off the render thread, split the atlas by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/245
* feat(mobs): foresee the animals of unexplored land from the seed by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/295
* docs(changelog): rewrite every entry as player-facing release notes by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/303
* fix(impostors): picture Ice and Fire mobs at their real size and from every height by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/293
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog before 1.21.6 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/304
* fix(offline): keep where players who logged off rest by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/247
* fix(mobs): stop still distant mobs gliding and trembling by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/306
* Enhance mob visibility and UI features for unexplored land by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/308

## What's Changed
* feat(ui): add Modrinth, CurseForge, Nexus Mods and website links by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/296
* feat(impostors): let Simplification Distance be turned off by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/302
* feat(ambient): change when easter eggs 3, 4 and 5 may come by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/299
* feat(players): show distant players gliding with an elytra by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/250
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/297
* feat(ui): draw distance settings in the world while they are set by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/298
* perf(impostors): find saved sheets off the render thread, split the atlas by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/245
* feat(mobs): foresee the animals of unexplored land from the seed by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/295
* docs(changelog): rewrite every entry as player-facing release notes by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/303
* fix(impostors): picture Ice and Fire mobs at their real size and from every height by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/293
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog before 1.21.6 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/304
* fix(offline): keep where players who logged off rest by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/247

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* feat(ui): add Modrinth, CurseForge, Nexus Mods and website links by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/296
* feat(impostors): let Simplification Distance be turned off by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/302
* feat(ambient): change when easter eggs 3, 4 and 5 may come by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/299
* feat(players): show distant players gliding with an elytra by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/250
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/297
* feat(ui): draw distance settings in the world while they are set by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/298
* perf(impostors): find saved sheets off the render thread, split the atlas by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/245
* feat(mobs): foresee the animals of unexplored land from the seed by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/295
* docs(changelog): rewrite every entry as player-facing release notes by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/303
* fix(impostors): picture Ice and Fire mobs at their real size and from every height by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/293

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* docs(readme): add a FAQ for the questions players ask most by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/264
* feat(players): say in the chat when the server does not share positions by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/252
* feat(ui): add a changelog button beside Discord's by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/277
* fix(ui): rename changelog record components so 1.20.1 compiles by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/282
* feat(impostors): show where each picture comes from and when it was baked by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/246
* feat(mobs): keep sitting pets sitting far away by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/287
* feat(track): draw other mods' vehicles far away, with settings of their own by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/261
* docs(readme): list the shader packs checked with the mod by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/289
* fix(ui): open the settings on 1.20.x without a crash by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/291
* Enhance vehicle rendering and UI for mod compatibility by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/288


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/compare/v0.13.0...v0.14.0
